Remote, Mouse & Keyboard

Control more from one app - now on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Remote, Mouse & Keyboard turns your Apple devices into a simple, powerful remote for TVs, streaming devices, Apple TV, Mac, Windows PC, and iPad. Use it from the couch, at your desk, during a presentation, or anywhere you want faster control.

TV and Streaming Remote

Use your iPhone, iPad, or Mac as a remote for supported TVs, streamers, and Apple TV.

Works with Apple TV plus supported Samsung, LG, Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, Hisense, and Vizio devices. Android TV and Google TV examples include Sony, TCL, Philips, and Xiaomi - just a few of the brands that use the platform.

- Navigate with a smooth touchpad
- Control volume, playback, and media
- Type searches and passwords with the keyboard
- Launch Apple TV apps quickly
- Keep one remote ready across your devices

Older Apple TV models such as Gen 1-3 require one-time PIN entry using a physical remote.

Mac and PC Control

Control your computer over Wi-Fi with a remote, mouse, keyboard, and custom panels built for the apps you use.

- Use your device as a wireless mouse and keyboard
- Adjust volume, playback, and tracks
- View your computer screen live
- Take screenshots remotely
- Launch or quit apps, open menus, and run shortcuts
- Create custom panels and automation scripts
- Schedule actions with timers

Requires the free helper app for Mac or Windows: https://rs.ltd/get

iPad Control

Use your iPhone, iPad, or Mac to control another iPad over Bluetooth.

- Type, navigate, and control playback
- Adjust volume and media
- Keep a second device useful in creative, work, or entertainment setups

Why You'll Love It

- One app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- Remote control for TVs, streamers, Apple TV, Mac, PC, and iPad
- Touchpad, keyboard, media controls, shortcuts, and automation
- Custom control panels for apps, websites, and workflows
- Secure Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections

System Requirements

- iPhone, iPad, or Mac
- Supported Apple TV, Samsung, LG, Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, Hisense, and Vizio devices
- Android TV and Google TV devices, including examples from Sony, TCL, Philips, Xiaomi, and more
- Apple TV: all models supported
- Mac: macOS 10.13 or later with helper app
- Windows: Windows 7 or later with helper app
- iPad control: Bluetooth connection
